why_this_direction: Marcos November17 approved the Final Experiment and requested its implementation and code review before restart. The previous70-leaf graph omitted468 learned tensors on the measured computation; the replacement derives every eligible leaf from the physical native inventory and retains the complete local loss.
repeating_pattern_check: Restricted parameter sets repeatedly looked like whole-path training because all105 losses were present. Inventory all601 stored tensors, explain exclusions, require connected derivatives for all538 eligible tensors, preserve every local residual, and compare actual native installation and fresh generation. Do not hide rises or label a passing fixture as capability repair.
hypothesis: Recurring computational divergence can be reduced by differentiating the selected wrong trace discrepancy from the fixed most-correct original trace into all contributing learned weights; reliable capability repair remains the research hypothesis.
what_went_wrong_before: The preceding70-tensor continuation included every loss merge but excluded468 eligible learned tensors before automatic differentiation. Correct full trace requests did not imply full weight coverage.
rule: One fixed reference, one freshly regenerated wrong response, all105 local position losses, full learned-parameter derivative, response-scaled single update with retained empirical eta and mixed-native remainder, joint installation, then fresh generation and remeasurement.
prediction: All538 eligible tensors are connected to the current computational graph; the installed native values and carried remainder are used on the next step. Fresh full-path loss can improve without exact-zero restoration. Its empirical trajectory, including increases, judges learning.
would_weaken_it: Detached eligible tensors or stale native values falsify implementation completeness. Sustained deterioration or stagnation of fresh loss despite correct plumbing weakens useful learning under the retained derivative estimator/eta.
